# Production Release Plan

Boruch Hashem. Blessed is He.

The Awtsmoos has carried the Road from hidden JavaScript toward server-visible Torah light;
Awtsmoos.com must now receive only the proven SEO vessels, never the shared worktree's unrelated flight.

## Release authority

The repository documents canonical Git production. Production activation requires an exact SHA on `origin/main`, a clean canonical production repository, fast-forward-only update, canonical server activation, and independent public verification.

The shared local worktree contains concurrent work from other agents and must not be staged wholesale. `npm run ship` is forbidden here because it stages all changes.

## Isolated release vessel

Create a temporary Git worktree from freshly fetched `origin/main`.

Copy only these proven SEO source files from the shared working tree into the isolated worktree as whole files:

1. `ayzarim/awtsmoosDynamicServer/mimes.js`
2. `geelooy/heichelos/heichel/_awtsmoos.heichel.html`
3. `geelooy/heichelos/post/_awtsmoos.post.html`
4. `geelooy/heichelos/post/initial-content.html`
5. `geelooy/heichelos/post/reader-settings.html`
6. `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/createRoutes.js`
7. `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/postReader.js`
8. `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/readerData.js`
9. `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/publicHeichels.js`
10. `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/routes.js`
11. `geelooy/heichelos/routes/heichel/sitemap/xml.js`
12. `geelooy/robots.txt`
13. `geelooy/sitemap.xml`

Do not copy `.ai-thoughts` or unrelated modified/untracked paths.

## Release gates

- Exact isolated `git status` may contain only those 13 paths.
- Full isolated diff must be reviewed.
- JS syntax, route import, XML parse, repository hygiene, and relevant Heichel tests must pass.
- Start an isolated server from the release worktree and rerun robots/sitemap/Heichel/Road acceptance.
- Fetch `origin/main` immediately before publication. If upstream moved, rebuild or rebase the isolated release and rerun gates.
- Commit only the exact audited files.
- Push exact commit fast-forward to `origin/main`.
- Activate that exact SHA with the canonical `bhRelease` production path.
- Verify `https://awtsmoos.com/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/heichelos/sitemap.xml`, `/heichelos/ikar`, and the target Road from outside production.
- Keep rollback evidence until public verification is green.
